$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows; Workit writes it and keeps your value.

locale.description: The language of Workit's prompts and drafts, e.g. en or es-419.

localeOptions.description: The locales the setup wizard offers.

branchPolicy.description: The global branch policy; a workspace's `branchPolicy` overrides it.

preset.description: The branch model: gitflow, github-flow, trunk-based or custom.

allowed.description: Branch name globs a new branch must match.

commitPolicy.description: The global commit policy; a workspace's `commitPolicy` overrides it.

preset.description: The commit message flavor, e.g. conventional.

pattern.description: A regular expression every commit subject must match.

updates.description: How an interactive launch handles a newer release: prompt (default), auto or off. Set with `workit upgrade --set-updates`.
